guide.summary: OpenProject uses an OAuth2 authorization code flow per instance, with Auth and Token URLs under the instance host. The default api_v3 scope covers the REST API for reading work packages as the authorizing user. Each customer instance's administration must register the app to get a client ID, secret, and redirect URL. GET /api/v3/work_packages is paginated by offset and pageSize. Visible work packages depend on the connected person's account permissions, which must be checked first. Read-only use needs no write or delete grant, but the api_v3 token itself is not read-only. Setup and execution are untested.
guide.recommendation: The requested access is documented. Follow the saved setup steps and run each representative API test; execution has not been verified.

findings.title: api_v3 scope for the standard OpenProject REST API
findings.detail: api_v3 is the standard OpenProject API scope and is assumed when no scope is checked. It covers the documented v3 endpoints, including listing work packages, on behalf of the authorizing user. The scope does not limit the token to read-only or to specific work packages. Read-only use depends on the app making only GET calls.

steps.title: Read first page of work package titles
steps.detail: Call GET /api/v3/work_packages with pageSize=25 and filters=[] (URL-encoded as %5B%5D) using the bearer token. offset is a page number and defaults to 1. steps.doneWhen: HTTP 200 response with _embedded.elements read for subject values, and total and count present at the collection level. Boundary check: only GET is sent; confirm the outgoing request log contains no PATCH, POST or DELETE calls and that the token grants api_v3 only.
